description:
32 pages : 20 cm

Learn all; about the well-known website and app Pinterest with fun projects inspired by its features and functions. Gather ideas on an inspirational pin board, put images of your favorite things on display, and produce how-to guides for your very own projects. Step-by-step directions and colorful photos bring each project to life. -- Publisher description
